hub.label: Footsteps
hub.desc: Surfaces, sound regions, distance, spatial audio.

steps.hint: GM detects token movement and broadcasts spatial step sounds to all players
steps.realisticDesc: Random pitch & volume variation each step
steps.fadeDurationHint: Sound fades linearly from full volume to silence over this window (ms). Does not affect step frequency.
steps.spatialDesc: Full directional sound: left, right, front, behind, diagonals — works best with headphones
steps.wallsDesc: How walls between token and listener affect volume
steps.wallHintNone: Walls have no effect on footstep volume.
steps.wallHintBlock: Any wall between source and listener completely silences the sound.
steps.wallHintAttenuate: Each wall on the path halves the volume. Three or more walls = complete silence.
steps.regionsHint: Assign a footstep sound to specific scene regions. When a token enters a region its sound overrides the default; when it exits it reverts.
steps.regionsEmpty: No regions configured. Add a binding below.
steps.regionExists: A region with that name is already configured.
steps.regionDistHint: Distances are optional — leave blank to use the global settings.
steps.soundRegionsHint: Assign a footstep surface to a specific scene region. The surface plays while the token is inside; default resumes on exit.
steps.distRegionsHint: Override the fade distances for footsteps inside a specific region. Sound regions and distance regions are independent and can overlap freely.
steps.distRegionsFieldHint: At least one field is required. Leave blank to inherit the global setting.
steps.noRegionSelected: Select a region on the canvas first.

notifications.noToken: Select a token on the map!
notifications.vnGmOnly: VN opened only for you (GM-only mode)
notifications.bgVariantRequired: Add at least one variant with a file.
